_comment: S9 delinquency behavioral fixture. KZ510B reads KZDLQF (overdue accounts) and writes KZDLRF (late charge + status). GOLDEN applies a 10-day grace to the 遅延損害金 (D-1503, tribal) and escalates status to '30' 回収 at >=61 days overdue (D-1502, doc-text/state-machine). START applies NO grace (over-charges) and caps status at '10' 延滞 (never escalates). The grader recomputes the GOLDEN expectation from this fixture independently of the golden code: charge = trunc(amt * 0.146 * max(0, days_overdue - 10) / 365); status = 00 if days<=0, 10 if 1..60, 30 if >=61. as-of = 20250601. CRITICAL SEPARATION TRAP: the 10-day grace applies to the late-CHARGE only; the status aging uses RAW days-overdue. A009 (exactly 10d) has charge 0 (grace) yet status 10 (延滞) — an agent that wrongly applies grace to the aging would get days 0 -> status 00 and fail. Boundary rows: A007 (exactly 61d -> 回収 '30'), A008 (exactly 60d -> 延滞 '10', NOT 回収), A009 (exactly 10d -> charge 0, grace edge), A010 (11d -> charge on 1 day). Short-overdue (A001/A005) isolate the grace axis; long-overdue (A003/A004) also exercise the collection trigger.

accounts.axis: collection just-below (exactly 60d -> 延滞 '10', not 回収)
grace boundary (exactly 10d -> charge 0; status 延滞 from RAW days)
grace+1 (11d -> charge on 1 day past grace)
